The / menu’s field

The / menu open at a standard 80 × 24 window, dark and light, drawn from the app’s own band, bar and list. Each look after “/” and after “/co”.

Decided

  • The menu stays open when no command matches, and says so. A second slash, or ↵ on something that is there, makes it a path.
  • The field’s › sits in the list’s column.
